correctness.rationale: For the precise labelled GP(10,2) with twenty vertices and thirty edges, every vertex has open neighborhood size three. The degree lower bound excludes total dominating sets of size at most six; an independent exhaustive scan of all C(20,7)=77520 and C(20,8)=125970 candidate subsets finds no size-seven total dominating set and exactly 190 minimum size-eight sets. Building every one-out/one-in swap independently gives 360 undirected edges, degree distribution (40 isolated, 120 of degree 4, 30 of degree 8), and components of sizes 150 plus forty singletons; BFS from every vertex of the nontrivial component gives eccentricity 10. Independent enumeration of all C(20,12)=125970 potential induced chordless cycles returns exactly 40, whose complements agree setwise with all isolated minimum dominating sets. Independently enumerated automorphisms total 120 with the stated five orbits and 30/10 isolated induced shapes. This genuinely exhausts the finite domain; no assertion extends to all cubic graphs.

It is not merely the previously known domination number, and researchers considering reconfiguration or fullerene obstructions could need these precise finite facts.
